origin.tgcshenanigans.dove.name: Colombe d'Marie
origin.tgcshenanigans.dove.description: A holy, rarely-seen distant cousin of the Avian. Attunement to that above has allowed them to keep their wings, but has consequently made them a target of the eldritch and decaying.
power.tgcshenanigans.dove/dove_lightbody: Your body is much lighter, designed for flight. You don't take any fall damage, and exhaust slower from moving around.
power.tgcshenanigans.dove/dove_aireffici: You can move just as fast in the air as you can on the ground– any movement speed bonuses will also apply to air speed.
